answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 167755 Country: India Title: If someone is lost which Dua should be recited for his welfare and comeback? Question: If someone is lost which Dua should be recited for his welfare and comeback? Answer ID: 167755 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 482/428/H=05/1440) After each salah and at the time of going to bed, read انا لله وانا اليه راجعون eleven times with durood 11-11 times before and after, and keep supplicating for wellbeing and recovery. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
